races.title: Golden Scoop Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: The Skelton yard continue to carry all before them so PALAMON is selected to supplement his recent Wetherby success from 7 lb higher. Kayf Dancer showed much more of what he's about at Ffos Las last month so he's taken to edge out Kent de Thaix for the forecast spot. PALAMON (IRE) KAYF DANCER KENT DE THAIX (FR)
races.bettingForecast: Kent De Thaix (11/8), Palamon (2/1), Kayf Dancer (2/1)

races.title: Steve Martin Memorial EBF Junior 'National Hunt' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: LOW TIDE has a useful jumping pedigree and the booking of top rider Danny McMenamin signals intent, so he's selected to make a successful start to his career. Invino Honnetete carries a penalty for winning on debut at Bordeaux last month and can put his experience to good use, while Navrom is another newcomer to note for a powerful yard. LOW TIDE (IRE) INVINO HONNETETE (FR) NAVROM (FR)
races.bettingForecast: Low Tide (15/8), Invino Honnetete (2/1), Navrom (11/4), Fiery Logic (10/1), Jubilate (14/1), Dundeelin (80/1)

races.title: Ice Cream Direct UK Members Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: MATTY'S MATE found only a fellow newcomer too good in a Newton Abbot bumper back in the spring and his pedigree strongly points to him improving on that now switched to hurdling over a longer distance, so he's a straightforward choice to go one better in a thin-looking race. Masterius offered disappointingly little on his recent hurdling debut, so Dshipdatnevrsailed , who was runner-up on his second outing in Irish points, is preferred for forecast purposes. MATTY'S MATE (IRE) DSHIPDATNEVRSAILED (IRE) MASTERIUS (FR)
races.bettingForecast: Matty's Mate (4/7), Masterius (5/2), Landsborough (10/1), Regal Thunder (18/1), Dshipdatnevrsailed (22/1)

races.title: Kelly's Dairy Soft Ice Cream Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: TOOTHLESS looked as good as ever when making a successful reappearance at Ffos Las last month so Paul Nicholls' consistent 8-y-o gets the nod to follow up at the expense of Cuban Court , who had a productive 2025/26 with 3 wins at this track and is fancied to come forward from his return. The enigmatic Primoz rounds off the shortlist. TOOTHLESS (FR) CUBAN COURT (IRE) PRIMOZ (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Cuban Court (2/1), Toothless (5/2), Bowmore (5/2), Primoz (17/2), Jaipaletemps (12/1), Il Ridoto (28/1)

races.title: Cadburys Ice Cream Novices' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: NOBODY TOLD ME hacked up at Southwell on Tuesday and can defy a penalty to make it 2-2 for Dan Skelton. Moi Mon Vieux and Blue Sky Dreaming appeal most of the remainder. NOBODY TOLD ME MOI MON VIEUX (FR) BLUE SKY DREAMING

races.title: Apres Village At Doncaster Racecourse 'Hands & Heels' Handicap Hurdle (Conditional/Amateurs)
races.verdict: A trappy race. BRIGHT LEGEND has fallen to a tempting mark and could capitalise if taking up this engagement. Hurdling debutant Sledgehammer has to be feared in his bid to make it 4-4 for Adrian Keatley, with front-running Biglesisback also expected to give a good account. BRIGHT LEGEND (IRE) SLEDGEHAMMER (IRE) BIGLESISBACK
races.bettingForecast: Sledgehammer (13/8), Biglesisback (7/2), Bright Legend (4/1), Vaguely Royal (6/1), Johnny Moonshine (7/1), Glitz And Glamour (16/1)
